item.description:
• Questions that need your call now actually reach you: mail that parks for your decision pings you on Telegram and lands a Studio card, instead of waiting silently.
  • You can tell your kit whose address is whose: link allowlisted emails to people it knows, and mark your own addresses as yours.
  • Mail from you is met as you: your kit grounds it in your shared history instead of treating you like a stranger.
